item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Govern MCP tools with your own gateway in Microsoft Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry Agent Service now supports public preview for routing MCP tool traffic through organization-managed AI Gateway or Azure API Management endpoints. The MCP route is configured in the gateway first, then used by the agent service.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure API Management Application
item.description:
Azure API Management Applications is now in public preview for all customers, with no sign-up required. The feature helps organize APIs around consuming applications and manage application-level relationships.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management and Azure AI Gateway
item.description:
Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management and Azure AI Gateway is now generally available. It lets organizations centrally govern AI agents and MCP tools and enforce security and access policies at runtime.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Unified Model API in Azure API Management
item.description:
Azure API Management now provides a Generally Available Unified Model API for connecting applications to AI models from multiple providers through a single standardized interface. It reduces the need to manage provider-specific APIs and integration requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management
item.description:
Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management is now in public preview. The integration connects centralized governance with runtime enforcement for MCP servers and tools.

  • Source: Azure Updates
